cards.card_text: Paul says he wasn't including the sexually immoral of this world, or the greedy and swindlers, or idolaters.
cards.verse_text: I was not including the sexually immoral of this world, or the greedy and swindlers, or idolaters.
cards.snippet: …the sexually immoral of this world, or the greedy and swindlers, or idolaters.

cards.card_text: Then he lists who won't inherit the kingdom of God: the sexually immoral, idolaters, adulterers, men who submit to or perform homosexual acts, thieves, the greedy, drunkards, verbal abusers and swindlers.
cards.verse_text: Do not be deceived: Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor men who submit to or perform homosexual acts, nor thieves, nor the greedy, nor drunkards, nor verbal abusers, nor swindlers, will inherit the kingdom of God.
cards.snippet: Do not be deceived: Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor men who submit to or perform homosexual acts, nor…

cards.card_text: Do not be idolaters Do not be greedy Do not be lazy
cards.verse_text: Do not be idolaters, as some of them were.
cards.snippet: Do not be idolaters, as some of them were.

cards.card_text: That is an idolater That is a coward That is a liar
cards.verse_text: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater) has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
cards.snippet: …can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater) has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

cards.card_text: Then comes a hard list: the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
cards.verse_text: But outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
cards.snippet: …outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.

cards.card_text: The dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters and everyone who loves and practices falsehood are inside the city.
cards.verse_text: But outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
